root_idea.summary: The root centers on counting and enumeration, and on preparing or providing something for a future need.
root_idea.development: Its lexical branches extend from counting to number, collective quantity, being counted among a group, and bounded or recurring periods; the second principal branch concerns preparation, equipment, and readiness. Related extensions include perennial water and recurrent pain or events associated with a determinate interval.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Independent Quran-attested Form IV verb, normalized to its citation form.
Independent Quran-attested Form VIII verb, normalized from the inflected Quran form.
Quran-attested active participle, normalized from the masculine plural form.
Independent Quran-attested noun denoting preparation or equipment.
Feminine and plural inflections of the same passive participial lexeme are presented under the masculine singular citation form.

senses.definition: To count, number, reckon, or enumerate.
senses.usage_conditions: Used transitively for counting objects, people, periods, or other units; grammatical person, aspect, and voice do not create separate lexical senses.
A reported interpretation of the Quranic construction in 104:2 emphasizes repeated reckoning or enumeration.

senses.definition: To make numerous or increase in number.
senses.usage_conditions: A reported interpretation of the Quranic construction in 104:2 takes the causative form as expressing multiplication or abundance.

senses.definition: To make something a provision or reserve against misfortune.
senses.usage_conditions: A reported interpretation of the Quranic construction in 104:2 understands the object as wealth or property made into provision for future contingencies.

senses.definition: To prepare, make ready, or provide something for an affair.
senses.usage_conditions: Includes active and passive Quranic uses: something may be made ready or be prepared for a specified purpose.

senses.definition: To count or reckon a prescribed period.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic construction, the object is the waiting period whose days are to be counted or reckoned.

senses.definition: One who counts or reckons; a keeper of number or calculation.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic plural form denotes those engaged in counting or reckoning.

senses.definition: A number, count, or quantity composed of units; counted or specified in number.
senses.usage_conditions: It may refer to the number of people, years, months, or other units, and may qualify a period as numbered or countable.
A verbal noun of counting, used in Quranic expressions concerning the numbering or reckoning of people or things.

senses.definition: A number, prescribed count, or quantity of days, months, or other units.
senses.usage_conditions: In Quranic legal and calendrical contexts, it denotes the number or completion of days, months, or other counted units.

senses.definition: A prescribed waiting period before remarriage after divorce or the death of a husband.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic use concerns the period whose completion permits remarriage; its duration varies according to the relevant legal circumstance.

senses.definition: Preparation, prepared equipment, or provision for an affair.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic use denotes the preparation or resources a person should have made ready.

senses.definition: Counted, numbered, or specified in number.
senses.usage_conditions: Applies to a determinate number or period, including Quranic references to numbered days or a limited term.
The feminine plural and related forms can particularly convey fewness or a small, bounded quantity, though the participle itself may apply to numbers large or small.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To reckon, regard, or esteem someone or something as good, bad, or otherwise characterized.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive evaluative use, distinct from merely enumerating units.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To enumerate or recount one's qualities or achievements to one another, especially in mutual rivalry or boasting.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal Form III construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To share equally or divide something jointly with another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of sharing an inheritance or another thing between parties.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of pain, illness, insanity, or the effect of a venomous bite: to recur or return at intervals.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal or recurrent Form III use describing periodic return.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become numerous or exceed another number.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The Form V verb may describe increase in number.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To participate with others in qualities or advantages that can be shared.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported Form V use in a reciprocal or collective context.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To share or participate mutually in something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form VI reciprocal construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become numbered, counted, or reckoned.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form VIII quasi-passive use; its acceptability is discussed in the lexical tradition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To include something in a numbering or reckoning, and hence to take it into account or regard it as significant.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The prepositional construction بِهِ marks the thing counted or considered consequential.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a woman: to observe or keep the prescribed waiting period.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized Form VIII construction connected with عِدَّة.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make oneself ready or become prepared for an affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The Form X verb includes equipping oneself with the necessary apparatus or means.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To hasten or move quickly in walking or going.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A special quadriliteral formation recorded in Classical Arabic.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a sandgrouse: to utter its characteristic cry.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized and tentatively reported use; the related noun denotes the cry.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A cry used to chide a mule.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An imperative-like animal-driving expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Pustules appearing on the face, especially on a person of good appearance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized plural noun with a dermatological sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Multitude, abundance, or great quantity.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of something present in considerable number or amount.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A perennial or abundant source of water, such as spring or well water that does not run out.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Dialectal descriptions vary concerning whether the term implies much or little water; the common branch concerns enduring or well water rather than rainwater.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Old, established nobility or lineage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic expression applying the water sense of enduring antiquity to social standing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person's term of life or a recurring interval of time.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Classical uses include the ending of a man's lifetime and the interval at which someone habitually visits; these are broader than the Quranic legal waiting-period sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The years of a person's life, considered as a counted span.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized use referring to the portion of life already numbered or remaining.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A day or occasion of giving.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In the expression يَوْمُ العِدَادِ, the noun can denote a customary day of gifts or payment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The day of the final presentation or judgment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional expression equating يوم العِداد with the day of final reckoning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A customary Friday or festival day on which one visits someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional temporal expression referring to a recurring communal occasion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A periodic interval, especially the interval at which the moon returns to a specified celestial station.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression concerning the Pleiades describes meeting or occurring once at a recurring lunar interval; traditional explanations differ on the exact period.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A recurring paroxysm of pain or fever at a determinate interval.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of the recurrent pain of a venomous bite and of intermittent or periodic illness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The appointed time of death.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized temporal use of عِدَاد.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A day or night when a deceased person's family gathers to mourn.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional funerary use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A recurring touch or affection resembling insanity or diabolical possession.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term may describe an episodic condition that returns at intervals.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The twanging or periodic pulsation of a bow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized use connected with repeated or intermittent sound.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person counted or registered as belonging to a tribe or group, despite lacking kinship there.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of enrollment among a people, including registration in a military or pensioners' register.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An equal or counterpart in number or quantity.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The comparison may concern equal multitude, quantity, or worth in number.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A lot, portion, or share of property or inheritance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Often used of property divided among sharers.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The time or period of an event or person's life.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in expressions meaning at the time of a person's action, life, or reign.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The first, best, or chief part of something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized temporal-metaphorical use, especially of the prime of youth or sovereignty.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To adopt the dress, language, manners, or rough way of life associated with the sons of Maʿadd; of a boy, to reach robust manhood.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The formation covers imitation of a traditional Arab mode of life and, in one use, becoming physically mature or coarse.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To withdraw or go far away into the country.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A distinct poetic use reported for the same special formation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Fully prepared or completely equipped.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used adjectivally of an army in the most complete state of readiness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The side of a man, horse, or similar body; specifically, the parts beneath the two boards of a saddle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized anatomical and saddlery term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The coarse and rude mode of dress associated with the sons of Maʿadd.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A cultural adjective derived from the Maʿadd branch.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person of good reputation whose outward appearance is unimpressive or contemptible.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Occurs in the proverb that hearing of the person is better than seeing him; the form is a diminutive derivative associated with Maʿadd.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Something included in a reckoning and therefore taken into account or regarded as important.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive participial expression with بِهِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The legs of a she-camel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized poetic usage of the plural form.

Evaluative use: reckoning something good or bad.

cautions: The Form II entry records several reported interpretations of the Quranic occurrence in 104:2; they are preserved as distinct senses rather than treated as interchangeable English glosses.
The active participle Quran group is normalized from the plural form عَآدِّين to the citation headword عَادّ, and the feminine passive-participle group is merged under مَعْدُود.
A Mufradat discussion of أَعْتَدَ and أَعْتَدَتْ as possibly related to this root is disputed and has no corresponding QAC form group here; it is not assigned as a Quranic form of عدد.
unassigned_or_ambiguous_evidence: The possible inclusion of أَعْتَدَ/أَعْتَدَتْ under this root is explicitly disputed in the supplied lexical discussion, while the QAC packet supplies no form group for it.
